name: account
title: Account
description: Read the API key name and current search allowance. No account secrets are returned.

name: get_search
title: Get Preyreach Search
description: Read the status and results of a search owned by this API key.

name: search_leads
title: Search Preyreach Leads
description: Submit a native REST search. Returns an id and pollUrl; use Get Search until completed. This consumes the API key search allowance.

prompt.description: Example: find dentists in Austin with website and phone.

name: enrich_search
title: Enrich Search
description: Enrich a completed search result without charging those leads again.
